sn45.139:1.1: sāvatthinidānaṁ → sāvatthiyaṁ (bj); sāvatthīnidānaṁ (sya-all) | Sāvatthinidānaṁ → B2 omits nidānaṁ. (pts note)
sn45.139:1.2: nevasaññīnāsaññino → nevasaññināsaññino (pts) | dipadā → dvipadā (bj: machasaṁ, syā, sī.pavi) | dvipadā → dipadā (cck: sī.) | bahuppadā → bahupadā (cck: ?) | dvipadā → S1-3 dipadā. (pts note) | nevasaññināsaññino → S1-3 nevasaññino vā nāsaññino (S3 -saññīno) (pts note)
sn45.139:1.5: bahulīkarissati → bahulīkarissatīti (bj, sya-all) | pāṭikaṅkhaṁ ariyaṁ aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ maggaṁ → paṭikaṅkhaṁ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam (pts) | paṭikaṅkhaṁ → S3 -kaṁkhā. (pts note) | bahulīkarissati → B1-2 -karissatī ti. (pts note)
sn45.139:1.6: bhikkhave → S1 inserts here bhikkha. (pts note)
sn45.139:1.8: aṭṭhaṅgikaṁ → aṭṭhaṅgakaṁ (sya-all) | eva → in S1-3 only. (pts note) | bahulīkarotīti → S1-3 -karoti. (pts note)
sn45.139:2.3: bahulīkarissati → bahulīkarissatīti (bj, sya-all) | vitthāretabbanti → This notice is missing in S1-3 and the "upari tīṇi suttāni" altogether suppressed; they are, on the contrary, fully exhibited in B1-2; we give only the number 4 by which they differ. (pts note)
sn45.139:3.6: bahulīkarotīti → bahulīkarotīti sāvatthīnidānaṁ (sya-all) | bhikkhave → evameva kho (bj: sī.pævi)
